prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” personal-injury lawyer for every Chicago car-accident case — the right attorney depends on your case facts (severity of injuries, liability issues, uninsured motorist, commercial/trucking, wrongful death, etc.) and on what matters to you (trial experience vs. quick settlement, communication style, budget). That said, Chicago has several highly regarded personal-injury firms with strong records in car-accident cases (for example, Clifford Law Offices, Salvi, Schostok & Patera, and Power Rogers & Smith are well-known locally). Rather than picking a single name, here’s a practical approach to find the best lawyer for your case.

How to choose the best attorney for your car-accident claim
- Look for relevant experience: attorneys who regularly handle car crashes, serious injuries, wrongful death, or commercial/trucking cases if that applies to you.  
- Trial experience: a willingness and record of trying cases to verdict usually gets better settlement offers.  
- Resources: firms that retain accident reconstructionists, medical experts, and investigators for complex cases.  
- Track record: past verdicts/settlements and client testimonials — but remember each case is unique.  
- Clear fee arrangement: most work on contingency (no fee unless you recover), typically 33–40% plus expenses; get it in writing.  
- Communication and accessibility: ask how often they’ll update you and who will handle your calls.  
- Reputation and discipline history: check reviews and the Illinois Attorney Registration & Disciplinary Commission (ARDC) for any public records.

Where to look
- Chicago Bar Association referral service and Illinois State Bar Association.  
- Directories and rating services: Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo, Million Dollar Advocates (useful but not definitive).  
- Local firm websites and client reviews.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases like mine have you handled? Outcomes?  
- Do you try cases or mostly settle? Trial experience?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day? Will I work with an attorney or a paralegal?  
- How do you charge (contingency percentage, costs, when costs are reimbursed)?  
- What’s your estimate of value and timeline based on my injuries?  
- What information or medical records do you need from me now?

Red flags
- Guarantees of a specific dollar amount.  
- Pressure to sign immediately.  
- No written fee agreement or refusal to explain fees/expenses.  
- Poor communication during the initial contact.

If you want, I can:
- Prepare a short list of well-regarded Chicago attorneys tailored to your ZIP code and case details, or  
- Provide a checklist and script for phone consultations, or  
- Walk through what evidence and documents to collect now to strengthen your case.

Tell me your ZIP code and a few basic facts about the accident (date, injury severity, whether fault is disputed, was the other driver insured) and I’ll give a tailored shortlist and suggested next steps.
